note: One row per body. Colour path: managed RCM, DaVinci Wide Gamut / DaVinci Intermediate timeline (decision 3). Camera and label names match capture-standard.md and resolve-template-spec.md. Curves: rpresolve/color.py (V-Log: Panasonic V-Log/V-Gamut Reference Manual Rev 1.0, 2014-11-28; HLG: ITU-R BT.2100).

cameras.profile: Blackmagic RAW, decoded as Film Gen 5
cameras.measure_linearise: measure from a Resolve-rendered ramp (no offline BRAW decode)
cameras.resolve_input_colour_space: auto (camera RAW): Resolve's RAW decode into DaVinci Wide Gamut, no per-clip tag
record_per_clip: BRAW Gen (5; Gen 6 only after the chart-day measurement, decision 22)

cameras.profile: HLG (the capture standard's Apple Log row is a separate profile)
cameras.resolve_input_colour_space: Rec.2100 HLG (Resolve's own name; unverified through the API, confirm on screen)
record_per_clip: ISO (as shown in the camera app, if shown)
Photo Style, when it is not V-Log

cameras.input_curve: DJI D-Log M (no published curve in this repository; to be measured)
cameras.measure_linearise: none: rpresolve.color has no D-Log M curve
cameras.resolve_input_colour_space: to be measured: detect sends these clips to review, because D-Log M is not in the headers
record_per_clip: Colour mode (Normal, D-Log M or HLG): it cannot be read from the file

cameras.profile: a recorder: the profile of the camera feeding it, over HDMI
cameras.resolve_input_colour_space: the feeding camera's row, from the com.atomos.hdr tags; review when no HDMI metadata reached the recorder
record_per_clip: Which body fed it, and that body's profile
